summary: Zoomcar Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the extension of its ongoing offer to exchange outstanding warrants for common stock. The offer, originally commenced January 23, 2026, and amended April 15, 2026, has had its expiration date extended from May 11, 2026 to June 30, 2026. No terms (exchange ratio, price) are given in this update. The board has not made a recommendation; no advisor is named. The offer is made under Schedule TO; holders are urged to read the offer materials. The extension suggests low participation or pending conditions (e.g., authorized share increase). Watch for participation levels and any further delays or amendments.
